contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragmentary copper-alloy gilded pin head of early medieval date (c. AD 700 - 800). The object is flat and would have been circular in form originally, although the edges of the object are now heavily chipped and broken.
